scripts.text: The day is not finished yet.
You can only help once a day. Hehe.
My pets are in the field outside of the village.
Why did they leave? Please find them.
Oh, thank you. You found all of 3 puppies.
I hope this is useful to you. hoho.
Are you an adventurer? You came here right on time.
And someone said that they saw them out on the field just outside the village....
It's pretty difficult and dangerous to find 'em.
Now I need to go tell Angelo.
Have you come here to hunt ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s?
Use it to capture a ^FF0000Strange Hydra^8B4513.^000000
I hope you can do it~!
came here and surrounded the town.
We're not sure what attracted them but some say that it's because of you adventurers.
In any case, to contain the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s,
you have to use this specially designed tool a.k.a. a ^8B4513Hydra Ball^000000
If you still have the ^006400Hydra Ball^000000,
please use it on the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s that
you can find at the beach.
If you are lucky, the tool will work perfectly.
Please make room and come back!
I will give you one more.
Ok, please do me a favor.

- You can't start the quest. Please reduce the weight in your inventory. -
Yo, do you know a berry called ^FF0000Guarana^000000?
Guarana is a really special berry raised in a specific area, it relieves physical fatigue, and gives power to the body. It even detoxes waste from the body.
I used to sell the candy made of it back in the day.
I got a prize sometimes every year in the <annual best product contest>. Those were the good 'ol days.
Since then, the output of that fruit has reduced and the price has gone up so now candy ingredients were changed to coconuts or other tropical fruits instead. I miss the guarana candy.
How can I taste this guarana candy?
Hmm? I already sold out of all my old supply.
But if you can find some guarana, I can make it for you.
Will you find the guarana?? Hoooooh~
Trading isn't my thing. Let me think.
Let me introduce you to someone with whom I used to do guarana business with.
He might still be dealing it.
If you can't find him in the city, go to museum.
He's a vain person so he likes to act big.
He's probably wandering in the museum trying to show off to someone for sure.
Don't you want to try the guarana candy?
If you want to get the guarana, find Cherto.
Maybe he will be in the museum.
- The guarana that I had has disappeared. -
- You give the guarana to him. -
It's the best thing I have ever seen so far. Cool~!
Long time no see my wonderful guarana candy...
- hash hash hash hash hash hash -
- hash hash hash hash hash hash -
Look! It's the popular guarana candy.
Try to savor its amazing taste hey~ take it easy. hahaha!!
Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
Since you helped me, guarana supply has been steadily rising.
So, naturally I'm back to making guarana candy.
What about it? Wanna buy some?
Here is a delicious guarana candy.
What? You should say before if you don't have money!
Even if you are poor, I can't give this away for free.
Sometimes some people don't like it due to it's arousal effect.
Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
Hmm... hey man, you are from outside, aren't you?
Cherto can figure it out even if it's the first time. You can't trick Cherto.
Cherto has sharp eyes like an eagle! Hahaha!
Ok, ok. Yes, yes. I see!
Anyway, you arrived in Brasilis but don't know what to do?
You don't know how fortunate you are to have found a really proper helper as myself.
Cherto takes it by your expression that you want to say, ''You are a master!'' Right?
Cherto, I can read and figure out all at once! That is written in your face!
Cherto would love to stay here and explain everything to you but he is a busy man.
If you have a curious thing to ask to Cherto. Cherto will be kind enough to answer.
What? Do you want to find a guarana?
Guarana is only raised in this area, it has a soft inside and is coverd with a light fur.
It seems a little bit weird but the flower is really big and smells beautiful.
A long time ago, guarana was used to relieve desease and thirst. But recently it's getting popular to revitalize body power and increase blood circulation.
Although it has such great effects, Cherto is sorry to inform you that we can't get it anymore.
For a while now, guarana berries haven't been growing here.
Even if Cherto managed to find one, it will rot quickly.
This story has been forbidden! Someone might be listening to our conversation...
If Cherto tells you, you might get us into trouble. But you look like you really wanna know so let me give you a tip.
Come closer. Cherto will whisper so nobody can listen in.
There was woman who was an expert botanist.
The woman was really popular to all living creatures.
At around the time her baby was born, she started a guarana farm. For some reason, her brothers were jealous so they destroyed the farm and disappeared.
We can't be sure that baby was born in the world but since that time, all guarana in Brasilis disappeared.
Pedro who is famous as a greedy man?
Meto who can't endure about all the fruits?
Will you figure out it? hohohhhhh~
Can you find the guarana kid?
- I tell Cherto about the kid making animal-like sounds. -
That kid might be a guarana kid. Sure...
According to the story the kid can have conversations with animals.
If he can make crying sounds of animals, they might be able to converse!
If he is the kid from the legend, is there any way to raise the guarana again?
In Brasilis there is an expert Mage.
Take this note over to him.
He will show the solution for you and the kid.
What can I say to him?
chamber pot braeee chamber pot brae chamber pot brae -
He makes strange sound like an animals.
Should I ask advice from Cherto?
He makes strange sounds like an animal.
Should I ask advice from Cherto?
I don't have a story but there are lots of friends waiting outside.
- You give the feather, fresh meat and branch of grapes to the kid -
kkk yes. Lots of friends want to meet you.
Don't be lonely anymore and be happy with your friends.
- He starts to smile lightly and laughs. -
Be a happy kid as always.
Do you want to say anything?
- You get closer and pretend to take caution. -
- The kid laughs again lightly then puts something in your hand. -
- It's a fresh berry that's colored red and hard. -
If I have this, I can make a guarana candy.
I better find that Candy Maker!
Hello. Mr. Cherto told me to find you.
Have you come here to ask about lots of weird rumors?
- You give the note to Paje-
But I will give you simple magic so you can figure it out by yourself.
It's a magic that will make you appear as an animal to other animals. Pretty cool huh?
Ok~ I will give you the magic.
Most animals are really sensitive so they might be aware of it. Find a Toucan in the field that's oblivious to the spell. You'll know when you talk to it.
It's the middle of the new and old continent... I know I've never seen you before but you seem familiar, like a woman dancing a samba.
I can feel some similar power like guarana kid. bbaaaeeeccc!
That kid has had a really lonely time, baaecc! Perhaps you are a friend of him? Baaeec!!
Not yet... but I want to be a friend.
The kid who received care from guarana woman is also a friend of animals. Bbaaeecc!
I'd like to give the symbol of a toucan representative for the kid. Bbaaeecc!
If you want to relieve his loneliness, can you help me?
We will keep our promise of friendship between guarana kid and Toucan forever. Bbaaeecc!
- You take a feather from Toucan. -
There have to be others around here like me.
Why don't you find a jaguar Bbaaeecc!
I will give a blessing from Toucan to you.
Smelling! This smell is from a human!
I don't have enough power to hunt humans, just waiting time to end my lifetime in this jungle.
Anyway you can talk with me, are you a guarana kid?
The son of guarana woman became our friend also.
I hope you are same the as her.
The son of guarana woman has a diseased heart.
Her brothers made him lonely, don't you think?
Here is fresh meat that I hunted just a few days ago.
Take it and give it to the poor kid.
I can give this tiny thing to you so, don't forget it.
The jungle will welcome you whenever!
- You get fresh meat from Jaguar. -
Monkey, who's always meddling with others, wants to meet you.
I will give you a Jaguar's high blessing.
Go to monkey by flowing through the wind like a bee.
We don't tolerate humans? Get out~!!
I can smell Jaguar from you, who are you?
Gosh, maybe there's no jaguar without fur and weird shape!
Are you saying that I look like an animal?!?!
Ahhha. Jaguar send you to me, right?? kkkikkki
But you don't look like guarana kid.
I've come here to help him.
I heard guarana kid became lonely, is he?
We are experts in acrobatic acts, does kid like it?? kkkickkksk!
Give this branch of grapes to guarana kid.
We will make him have fun during the whole night whenever he comes to us!! kkkickkksk!
- You get a bunch of grapes from Monkey. -
Good~ Now it's time to go back to the kid~!!
This climate offers special cases in botany classes different from any other regions of the world.
The plants here have robust frames and are clear and colorful.
Here the plants are really huge and we can feel their presence.
One of them, a Water Lily, is a really gorgeous and unique plant.
This flower is quite sensitive so it doesn't bloom everywhere.
I guess you aren't interested in botany.
It doesn't appear easily and it is a mysterious flower even to the natives, so the Brasilis people believe that a person will get great luck if someone finds it.
As a botanist, I have been hanging around here to find the lucky flower but as I expected, it hasn't shown itself yet.
I believe that with enough perseverence, this flower will show me it's beautiful brilliance.
Ah, if you are interested more in the Water Lily story, find someone named Marta.
She is wise and knows lots of stories here in Brasilis.
Ah, if you are interested more in the Water Lily story, find someone named Marta.
She is wise and knows lots of stories here in Brasilis.
- You show a lotus flower to Karmen and talk about the story so far. -
Wow!! You had a really good experience.
So~~~ the water lily lives in the depths of brasilis, right?
I wil try to find it again by myself, I won't give up!!
I am so grateful that I met you.
The water lily must truly be a lucky flower. hahaha
This climate offers special cases in botany classes different from any other regions of the world.
The plants here have robust frames and are clear and colorful.
Here the plants are really huge and we can feel their presence.
Grandma! That person has a weird smell.
The outsider has a weird name!
Thas ok! If we keep talking we'll be friends! Cheer up!
So, why have you come here stranger~?
I heard you knows lots of stories, is that true?
Wooo! how you know my grandma knows lots of stories, amazing~?
Grandma is really wise and kind so, I heard lotsa things.
Hehe. Kaka always listens to many stories every night, he really likes my stories.
Kaka always makes me happy because he asks so many curious things. That is pure happiness.
Ok, Kaka why don't you invite our guest today to our small meeting?
Hey~ do you have special story that you want to listen to?
It's from a long long time ago.
A tribe that lived with the giant waterfall and jungle as friends spent their whole time with nature.
One of tribe chiefs had a pretty daughter called 'Naia'.
Naia liked listening to stories like Kaka so, her mom told her stories every night about nature and gods.
Maybe she would be pretty... hehe.
If the moon in the sky loves some woman in the earth, he turns her into a star so that they can stay together forever.
After Naia heard this story, she went to her dad to ask if it was true or not.
^3131FF'My dear, Naia the moon is one of the bravest men. But he can no longer have a bride. So you can't become a star... Sorry~.^000000
Did Naia wants to be the bride of the man?
Yes Kaka, imagine the moon how beautiful and mysterious, that's just ideal for girls.
But the moon doesn't meet a human as his wife anymore? What was going on with Naia?
Naia was really a nice girl.
Although her parents tried to prevent her, she still went to the forest to meet the moon every night.
Sadly, even with all of her effort, the moon didn't show any reaction to her.
One day she also went to the top of the mountain to be closer to him. She decided to take a rest for a while around the lake.
It was the moon he was shining beautifully over the waving lake lightly.
I know, it's just the moon reflecting on the water. Right?!
Yes, but to her, the image made her fall into the lake without hesitating and drowned.
The moon was also watching her from the sky.
He felt sad and pitied her. So he decided to turn her into a beautiful flower to thank her for her love.
That is the story of the mysterious flower people called the Brasilis Water Flower.
This Naia flower appears as light white during daytime but in the night turns into red due to it's love connection to the moon.
If you want to listen to another story, just come to me.
If you don't mind playing with my grandson a ~ little. hoohoo.
My grandma is really a bit tired doing some tribe stuff!
You are not from around here.
I can sense a strange earth smell.
But your eyes shine with strength.
Indeed you are spreading out spirit and will from your whole body.
If you work at it you will be a great person someday.
- so you can't get any more items. -
Mom, I have to go out!!
What's up? Why are you looking at me?
I don't want to be a showgirl!! Get out!!
What's it matter to you that I'm rude??!!
I know that I'm just passing by but I might be able to help you. What do you think?
This kind of meeting could be more than just a coincidence.
Hmm can you tell me your name?
I have to meet 'Jasi' but I can't go out....
If he is my lover, it would be great... but...
Maybe... are you talking about the moon from the story?
Dear Jasi is from the moon from the sky!
Why are you thinking like that?
Cuz' Jasi is really gorgeous and the most important thing is he is taking care of the water lily in Brasilis.
Right. It's a really mysterious flower and difficult to find.
But around Jasi there are lots of water lilies.
That's why I believe Jasi is the moon.
He is deep inside the Jungle.
As you can see I am so weak so, I've been staying home. But once, I was strong enough to leave this village.
I just wandered the jungle and fell down somewhere and that's where I saw him.
He was so nice. He helped heal me and guided me back home.
That was really really great time.
Since I came back home, my parents punished me.
I can understand why they are worrying but i missed Jasi a lot!
Why don't you meet him after recovering your strength?
I wanna see him right now...
Sorry I can't help you. Cheer up!
Jasira I came here to find the Brasilis water lily.
Don't you think fate has brought us together?
If you tell me how to find Jasi, I can help you.
Really? But I don't know exactly how to get there. I was just wandering around when I met him.
If you know something you've gotta tell me.
Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
Good, that's better than nothing! I will look for a similar place.
I gave you your information, so can you do me a favor?
I'd like to give a delicious fruit.
The place where Jas seemed cozy but I didn't see any food around... So if he sees a yummy fruit he will be happy!
Give him 10 Banana and tell him that I really miss him.
Sorry for ignoring you before. Please, only you can help me!
If you meet Jasi, give him 10 Bananas.
Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
If you can't find the way, go up to the waterfall and ask the kids in Brasilis village.
I heard one of the children went to a strange place before. He might've gone to the same place as me!
Hey girl~ you've got a short temper.
I did see him and I talked about you!
That you have a really good heart~
I told him that you will try to meet him when your condition gets better.
Thank you! You are more reliable than I thought you would be.
Anyway, I'm looking for a fruit that's brown and has a hard shell.
It has juice inside and can be used as a cup to drink out of.
Duh! You mean a coconut right?!
I should take care of my strength by myself!
I can't just lie in my bed forever. Don't you agree?
Uh? Why have you come back?
- You tell her what Jasi told you to tell her -
Thanks to you, I was able to get a flower.
Ah... can I see it for a second?
I've been working on this hat while you were gone and now it's complete with the water lily flower!
I know, I know! I'm the best...
I just need to get a little bit stronger!
I can't just lie in bed forever. My Jasi is waiting for me~
Oh, I haven't seen another person in such a long time.
You don't have specific business with me.
My family has worked to take care of the water lily from generation to generation.

Basically the Brasilis water lily is too shy to appear in front of people so, they only bloom in rare places. I guess they like it here, though, that's why I've been staying here for such a long time.
My family has taken care of the water lily calmly to prevent harm from people's hand or monsters.
Do you remember a girl named Jasi.
Gosh.. I was in trouble due to that girl.
One day a young lady appeared with lots of scars so I helped her. Then suddenly she tried to pick up the water lily and asked me to accept her as my wife or make her into a water lily what a nutcase!
I was barely able to calm down and send her to the village.
My life is that water lily so I didn't want anything embarrassing to happen.
This is a gift from Jasira to say sorry for that time.
She is really sad that can't come here by herself due to private difficulties.
- Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
Ah! Bananas! Wow it's been a long time. She's pretty considerate isn't she?
Anyway is that all the business you have with me?
Umm honestly I was wondering to find water lily and met you by coincidence. Jasira told me her sad story so that's what led me here.
As you can see, there are lots of Brasilis water lily around here.
If you make sure that you won't destroy them you can appreciate them as you wish.
Did you enjoy the water lily?
I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
Now I remember thank you very much. I can't remember the last time I had this fruit.
I guess I should keep my promise.
You can take one Water lily.
I hope the Brasilis water lily will understand me.
You better grab the flower while you have a chance~
Oh, can you tell that girl Jasira something for me?
Tell her that I am not the moon from the story, but I want to become the moon to shine only for her.
The flowers blooming from the Water lily today is wonderful.
An unusual Water lily is blooming here. You can't stop staring at it, knowing that few people have seen this flower bloom.
- You can't avoid staring at it's beauty. -
There is a person who really needs this flower, can I just take one of 'em?
As I said earlier, I am the guardian of this water lily.
I can't just stand by here and watch you pluck even a single flower from it.
Hey man~ I brought these delicious fruits for you... try it! They are really well matured and fresh bananas.
- Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
Hmm... It's been so long since I've had this fruit.
I will just try one. That's all.
I remember my mom baking these into a tasty bread!
It makes me miss my childhood.
I've been here for as long as I can remember...
I don't have enough time to even do simple things like eat delicious fruit.
It was a really delicious banana.
Please! I just need one flower~ What can I do to convince you?
Rules are rules, what do you want from me?
Didn't that banana remind you of your childhood? What can I get for you?
Now that you mention it, there is one fruit that I really miss.
It was my favorite when I was young but I don't remember what it was called.
It's brown and has a hard shell around it. It has juice inside and you can use it as a cup when you're done eating the fruit.
Do you know what it is?
If you bring 5 of those things, I will reconsider your suggestion.
Ok so I have to bring 5 fruits with hard shells.
It was my favorite when I was young but I don't remember what it was called.
It's brown and has a hard shell around it. It has juice inside and you can use it as a cup when you're done eating the fruit.
Do you know what it is?

- You take a beautiful water lily carefully in your hands. -
Wow it's really a great statue!
This statue is called Verass Monument.
A long time ago there was a really brave adventurer named Verass, thanks to his dedicated exploration, Brasilis was able to develop into this great city.
i wanna become a real man like Verass.
Pedro, you can become whatever you want.
Mariana is so smart, isn't she? hehe.
Ooooh! You love her don't you!
Wooooaaaa Pedro and Mari sitting in a tree!
Hey guys, did you hear that something happened a few days ago?
Oh yeah~ I heard that something really scary happened.
Uh, yeah that's why Mariana got scared of going ot the bathroom for 3 days and everything was stinky. Ewwww~
Stop spreading rumors about me. I'm not scared of the bathroom.
Pedro, do you think that I stink?
Hey guys~ be nice to her~
Oh man you stink too~! Nya nya~
The ghost story in the art museum.
A coupla days ago we went to the art museum for a picnic at school.
You know nothing special, just a ordinary field trip.
Museums are boring so me and some friends snuck away from the group~!
That's when we heard a scream echoing through the whole museum.
You boys are always making noises where you're not supposed to.
What else are we supposed to do? If we don't do it someone else will.
Argh~ Boys are so frustrating sometimes.
Daniel and me guessed something weird was goin' on so we ran to where we thought the screams were comin' from.
They were coming from the bathroom.
Some kids got so scared that they started screaming too and closing their eyes. It got pretty bad.
I think you pissed or pooped your pants. It smelled freakin' gross.
Nah uh~ Your mom pissed her pants~ Nyah!
Nah uh~ You~ pissed your pants~
Anyway, so yeah, anyway that's how the rumor of the ghost in the museum started.
Liar, there's no such thing as ghosts~
No one could say they saw one and no one wanted to get in trouble from the teachers.
I heard if you say special magic words that the ghost will come out.
Quit butting into our conversation Pedro.
Yah, what are you talking about, Pedro?
So did you see the ghost?
N... no. I'm scared of ghosts.
But my friends said they saw one and they're not liars.
Did anyone tell you the magic words?
I heard it in a kind of song.
'^FF0000Turn the key as many times as there are colors in the rainbow.^000000'
'^FF0000If the moon disappears 3 times, don't worry.^000000'
'^FF0000Don't worry, the waterfall will help it.^000000'
'^FF0000Your 7 friends are sleeping. now it's time to wake them.^000000'
Umm it seems like a riddle.
Wanna help me find this ghost?
Pfft, I can't believe you're gonna believe that story.
I'll do whatever Fabio does, as always!
Do you wanna hear the magic words again?
'^FF0000Turn the key as many times as there are colors in the rainbow.^000000'
'^FF0000If the moon disappears 3 times, don't worry.^000000'
'^FF0000Don't worry, the waterfall will help it.^000000'
'^FF0000Your 7 friends are sleeping. now it's time to wake them.^000000'
I wonder what I need to do to have a statue made of me?
Can you guys stop talking about the ghosts?
I've already got goosebumps all over.
Why do Fabio and Daniel always bother us?
You still wasting your time with that ghost story?
Keke Here~ I found more bugs~
- A key is inserted in the locked door.-
You start saying the first line of the magic words.
Seems like you said something wrong.
'^FF0000Turn the key as many times as there are colors in the rainbow.^000000'
How many times should I try to knock?
You knocked on the door {0} times.
How many times should I turn the key?
Faint laughing can be heard off in the direction of the toilet.
You turned over the key {0} times.
How many times should I insert the key into the door?
- A key is inserted in the locked door.-
After flushing the toilet, you suddenly feel dizzy and are suddenly swept away somewhere.
The water in the toilet looks gross.
- What was the second line to that spell now? -
Seems like you said something wrong.
^FF0000If the moon disappears 3 times... don't worry.....^000000
How many times should I flush?
Suddenly the sink sounds like water is flowing freely from it.
Faint laughing can be heard off in the direction of the faucet.
You close the lid of the toilet.
- It seems like an ordinary faucet -
- What was the next line to that spell now? -
Seems like you said something wrong.
^FF0000Don't worry... the waterfall will help it....^000000
How many times will you tap the faucet?
How many times should I turn the water on?
You turn the faucet on once.
Faint laughing can be heard off in the direction of the carpet.
You turn the faucet on {0} times.
- It seems like an ordinary faucet -

Seems like you said something wrong.
^FF0000your 7 friends....are...sleeping... now it...'s time ....to wake them........^000000
How many times should I jump?
You jump on the carpet {0} times.
How many times should I lie on the carpet?
You lie on the carpet {0} times.
How many times should I shake the carpet?
- fly~ fly~ fly~ fly~ fly~ fly~ fly~ -
Faint laughing can be heard off in the direction of the mirror.
- A carpet with an intricate pattern on it -
- You can see a clean mirror without any marks or dust -

Seems like you said something wrong.
The stories about the ghost are true~!
- You take a deep breath and then look at the Ghost and notice it has an eye patch -
^FF0000My eyes are so tight... can you take this off?^000000
You step carefully towards the ghost.
His face was covered with dust making strange contortions with it's face.
The Ghost disappeared into the toilet.
You run away from the ghost.
- You can see a clean mirror without any marks or dust -
I'm sorry but this area is under construction right now.
What can I do for you?
I need to use the bathroom.
Sorry we are remodeling inside right now so, it's closed.
But my manager ordered me to stop anyone from entering this bathroom so, I should follow his orders.
It's always hot in Brasilis but today is ridiculously hot.
Maybe I need to drink some coconut juice to cool down.
You give a coconut to the Curator.
Oh really can I have it?
Ok I'll let you through this one time.
The curator looks around calmly then opens the door.
You give up trying to enter.
What can I do for you?
I need to use the bathroom.
Sorry we are remodeling inside right now so, it's closed.
But my manager ordered me to stop anyone from entering this bathroom so, I should follow his orders.
It's always hot in Brasilis but today is ridiculously hot.
Maybe I need to drink some coconut juice to cool down.
You give up trying to enter.
Hey thanks for the Coconut earlier it really helped me cool down.
Is it just me? Or is it hotter than it's ever been today!
I am a ghost who died while wandering the jungle many years ago.
I found a pipeline in the jungle and followed the voice of a man to this very spot.
That's also where I hurt one of my eyes while walking around in the dark.
I wandered these sewers for days until I found the end of this line connected to the toilet in the museum. I shouted forever begging for help but no one answered my calls.
You finally answered my call but it's already way too late. Thank you for at least checking. No one else has bothered to this day.
There are many dangerous creatures at the end of this sewer.
You seem brave though. I bet you wouldn't worry about the monsters there anyways.
I guess now I can finally rest in peace.
You see a rusty pipe. It seems to be linked to somewhere beneath the jungle.
You swim through a gap in the pipe and are swept by a sudden rush of water.
It might be dangerous, I better not act rashly.
You see a rusty pipe. It seems to be linked to somewhere beneath the jungle.
I don't require your help at this time.
Um... it seems to be okay.
I'll make you a potion which will
Please block the Iara threatening the security of the tribe.
You haven't brought enough materials yet.
We cannot make the purification potion with only these.
Ah... we need a strong adventurer.
The tribe is facing a major threat.
the adventurer who came for the
Maybe because of the purification potion...
After that, the Iara stopped seducing tribesmen but the effect didn't last long.
